simple.meaning: עוּל (ʻûwl) is a Hebrew word meaning “a babe.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עוּל (H5764) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 24:9, with occurrences in Job, Isaiah.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עוּל (H5764) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: עוּל (ʻûwl) / H5764 is traced through Job 24:9, Isaiah 49:15, Isaiah 65:20 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
